requirements: serverId is nonblank and is the exact stable server identity
userId is nonblank and is the exact stable user identity
the active identity generation is known
forbiddenOnUnknown: fallback to no-account or another account
unknownIdentityPolicy.observable: IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE; no cached payload is projected

canonicalKey.materialRule: For every dimension marked logicalDigest=true, in order, append decimal UTF-8 byte length, colon, normalized value, LF. Then append the cache schema version and key version.
canonicalKey.digest: SHA-256 over the length-prefixed material; persist lowercase hex
canonicalKey.collisionRule: A digest match without exact envelope identity checks is a miss; never treat a hash match as identity proof.
canonicalization: Omit absent values; distinguish absent, empty string, and explicit false.
Percent-decode exactly once before canonical query-shape encoding.
Sort unordered sets; preserve order where server semantics are ordered.
Normalize locale to canonical BCP-47; preserve all server-affecting language and region variants.
Scope-derived includeItemTypes and all non-null behavioral query parameters are part of queryShapeSha256.

dimensions.normalization: fixed integer string; incompatible key changes increment it
ONLINE_ACCOUNT or SAVED_OFFLINE_ACCOUNT; no anonymous fallback
exact stable opaque ID; reject blank, whitespace-only, NUL
exact stable opaque ID; reject blank, whitespace-only, NUL
versioned resource family such as search, items, home, item-detail
enum resource type; unknown value fails closed
exact stable resource ID or explicit ABSENT sentinel
exact stable parent/library ID or explicit ABSENT sentinel
normalized product scope such as ALL, VIDEO, MUSIC, BOOK
SHA-256 of the complete canonical request shape; see queryShape
non-negative decimal integer or explicit NOT_PAGED sentinel
positive decimal integer or explicit NO_LIMIT sentinel
ordered sortBy values plus sortOrder, or explicit SERVER_DEFAULT
complete canonical filter/facet tuple or explicit NONE
ordered fields, image/user-data switches, or declared server default
canonical BCP-47 request locale plus server-affecting language region
version of the decoded value contract
version of TTL and invalidation semantics
durable monotonic namespace generation; envelope and full lookup tuple only

mustInclude: parentId, ids, paging, sorting, fields, images, filters and facets when present
effective locale or language-affecting request variant

verificationOrder: logical key and digest exact match
